 Warm now, rainy later? 
 By Shelden Breshears Published : Oct. 21, 2026 at 4:44 AM CDT | Updated : 15 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google We’re waking up to higher 50°s and quiet conditions as we start our Wednesday. Looking forward to the rest of the day, we’ll see some of our calmest winds we’ve seen all week, and with partly cloudy skies and a high pressure aloft, we’ll get highs to their warmest point as well, with 80°s expected.
 Looking to Friday and the incoming weekend, we’re tracking better rain chances to begin to move in! Things will start Friday-Saturday primarily in the west, but pushing a little into the panhandle. Then Sunday is when we see the best shot at more widespread rain for more of the region.
